hints.title: Decoupled Event Handling
hints.text: Components need to register interest in named events, trigger callbacks with dynamic arguments, and clean up subscriptions individually. How can events and listeners be organized?

hints.title: Subscription Registry Mapping
hints.text: Maintaining a map from event names to arrays of callback functions enables dispatching notifications, while returning an unsubscription handler allows clean removal of individual callbacks.

hints.title: Registry Array Storage and Filtering
hints.text: Create a Map storing arrays of callbacks keyed by event name. When subscribing, append the callback and return an object with an unsubscribe method that removes that specific callback from the array. When emitting, look up callbacks and return an array containing each callback result.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Map lookup followed by sequential callback dispatch.
